title: Patchwork Collab Docket (ad-hoc cross-team tracker)
content:
Patchwork Collab Docket — quick cross-team roster and lightweight coverage table

Purpose:
- One-page lightweight spreadsheet for ad-hoc cross-functional asks that pop up during launches, incident after-action, or last-minute customer requests.
- Designed as a temporary coordination surface (72h life typical) to reduce pinging multiple owners.

How to use:
- Add a single row per ask; keep terse.
- TTL = how long this ticket needs active attention before either resolved or escalated to normal backlog.
- Status: quick states only (open / in-progress / awaiting-input / done / escalated).
- Owner = person committing to next visible action.

CURRENT SNAPSHOT (generated manually during standup 2031-09-15 09:10 PT):

Columns: ID | Short ask | Owner | Team | Priority | TTL (hrs) | Status | Blocker | Last update
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1 | Quick fallback policy for EU region spikes (capacity handoff doc + play) | Marco DeLuca | eng-infra | high | 48 | in-progress | need spike run numbers from SRE | 2031-09-15 08:50
2 | Customer B data residency checklist for Private trial | Priya Shah | sales-eng | critical | 24 | awaiting-input | legal signoff on DPA clause pending (JIRA:LEGAL-339) | 2031-09-15 07:30
3 | Short-term throttling rule for embedding-heavy routes | Lina Chen | product-hosted-api | medium | 72 | open | awaiting rate-card from billing | 2031-09-14 21:10
4 | Hand-over notes for weekend oncall (mini playbook) | Aaron Velasquez | sre | low | 8 | in-progress | someone to proofread runbook | 2031-09-15 09:00
5 | Quick validation: quantized model perf delta on 4k tokens | Ethan Kim | applied-ml | high | 36 | open | need sample prompts from docs team | 2031-09-15 06:45
6 | Demo environment refresh for channel partner kickoff | Maya Pritchard | solutions | medium | 12 | awaiting-input | permissions for partner workspace | 2031-09-15 08:05
7 | Temporary routing exception for dedicated customers A/B | Samir Patel | platform-engineering | high | 16 | escalated | conflict with autoscaler policy (PR:GH/infra#457) | 2031-09-15 08:20

Quick metrics (not formal):
- Active rows: 7
- High/critical: 4
- Avg TTL remaining: ~32 hours
- Primary blockers: legal signoffs (1), infra telemetry (2), billing data (1)

Top 3 friction points observed while using this docket:
1) Legal and billing approvals are frequently the longest tail — add an explicit reviewer tag next time and estimate SLA for approvals.
2) Owner ambiguity: when row owner is a team alias, action stalls. Always assign a named person.
3) Duplicate asks: same underlying ask appears in SLAs + partner rollout docs; we should add a quick canonicalization step (check Confluence link column)

Immediate requests / asks for next 8 hours:
- Marco: run a light spike (2 hours) on EU node pool and paste 95th latency numbers to row 1 by EOD.
- Priya: ping Legal (Ava) with the DPA draft; add Legal reviewer to row 2.
- Lina: fetch billing rate-card snapshot (billing-run id) and attach to row 3.
- Aaron: publish the weekend mini playbook to /sre/oncall/adhoc and request a 1-hour review.

Decisions taken in last 24h (record):
- Small routing exceptions will be handled as temporary feature flags with TTL <= 24 hours (Samir + infra agreed).
- No new dedicated capacity will be carved without a resource re-alignment note and cost estimate (product + finance).

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Add a tiny column next time for "expected deliverable" (e.g., doc link, PR link, spreadsheet) to reduce back-and-forth.
- If any row sits >72 hours, escalate to triage board and create a formal ticket.

Raw links / refs (copy-paste):
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/CB-interop-2021
- JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-14287
- GH PR (routing): https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/457
- Slack: #ops-handshake (pinned message: "docket-quick-ops")

Changelog (quick):
- 2031-09-13 10:02 — template created (Ethan)
- 2031-09-14 20:45 — rows seeded during partner kickoff prep (Priya, Marco)
- 2031-09-15 07:30 — row 2 updated with legal ticket ref (Priya)
- 2031-09-15 08:50 — row 1 owner confirmed and spike scheduled (Marco)

Last note: keep this sheet intentionally lightweight — if more than 10 concurrent rows are active, split into a proper tracker in product-ops and create a JIRA epic.
